_readme: One entry per sprite. Final prompt = subject + style (with {GRID}). big: also exported at 64x64 (beasts and dragons drawn over 2x2 tiles). Generate with: node art/gen.mjs [slug...]
style: Pixel art sprite for a retro 2D action game in the style of 16-bit SNES era games. A single subject, full body, centered and filling most of the frame. Crisp chunky square pixels on a regular pixel grid, as if drawn at {GRID} pixels and upscaled with nearest neighbour. No anti-aliasing, no gradients, no dithering noise. Limited palette of about 16 saturated colors, a strong 1-pixel dark outline around the silhouette, simple shading with one highlight and one shadow tone. Background: perfectly flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF (never black, never dark, never a scene) filling the whole image edge to edge, nothing else in the background, no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no border, no frame.
negative: photorealistic, 3D render, smooth shading, blurry, gradient background, text, watermark, signature, multiple characters, cropped, frame

sprites.subject: Saint George (Sant Jordi) as a young medieval knight on foot, three-quarter view facing right: silver plate armor and chainmail, white surcoat with a large red cross (the Saint George cross), open-faced silver helmet with a small red plume, red cape, holding a long sword upright.
The princess of the Catalan Saint George legend, three-quarter view facing right: long golden-blond hair, small gold crown, long rose-pink gown with gold trim, holding a single red rose.
An old medieval king, three-quarter view facing right: long white beard, gold crown with red gems, red cloak with white ermine trim over a purple robe, holding a golden sceptre.

A medieval Catalan shepherd, three-quarter view facing right: red barretina (traditional Catalan wool cap) flopping to one side, short brown beard, white sheepskin vest over a green tunic, red sash, rope sandals (espardenyes), holding a wooden shepherd's crook.
A medieval Catalan crossbowman, three-quarter view facing right: iron kettle hat, padded tunic with vertical yellow and red stripes (the Catalan flag), holding a loaded wooden crossbow.

Soler de Vilardell, a 14th-century Catalan knight, three-quarter view facing right: dark steel full plate armor, closed great helm, blue surcoat with a gold cross, holding a magic sword whose blade glows pale cyan.

Santa Jordina, a brave young princess-knight, three-quarter view facing right: long orange-red braided hair, small gold crown, silver breastplate over a pink skirt, holding a lance with a small red pennant.
Sant Mer, a medieval hermit monk from Banyoles, three-quarter view facing right: tonsured head, short beard, brown wool habit with a rope belt, carrying a coiled white rope over the shoulder.

Miguel de Cervantes, early 17th-century writer, three-quarter view facing right: balding, brown hair, moustache and pointed goatee, large white ruff collar, black doublet, holding a quill pen in his right hand, left arm limp at his side.

William Shakespeare as in the Chandos portrait, three-quarter view facing right: high bald forehead, shoulder-length brown hair, short beard and moustache, small gold earring, plain white collar, dark doublet, holding a small book.

A mysterious medieval beggar, three-quarter view facing right: ragged brown hooded cloak hiding most of the face, glowing yellow eyes in the shadow of the hood, long white beard, leaning on a wooden staff.
An olive-green snake coiled and ready to strike, side view facing right, forked red tongue.
A purple bat flying with spread wings, front view, glowing yellow eyes, small white fangs.
A grey wolf walking and snarling, side view facing right.
A big green frog crouching, front view, yellow eyes, pale belly.
A Barcelona city pigeon standing, side view facing right: grey body, iridescent green and purple neck, pink feet.
A seagull standing, side view facing right: white body, grey wings with black tips, yellow beak with a red spot.

A 'diable' dancer from a Catalan correfoc (ball de diables), three-quarter view facing right: red and black costume with a hood with two small horns, holding up a pitchfork-shaped 'forca' with a spinning firework spraying golden sparks.
A small young dragon, side view facing right: olive-green scales, yellow belly, small bat wings, short tail.
The dragon of the Catalan Saint George legend of Montblanc, side view facing right: large green scaly dragon with bat-like wings, long tail, sharp claws, a small flame coming out of its open jaws.
The dragon of Vilardell from the Sant Celoni legend, side view facing right: dark purple poisonous dragon with green venom dripping from its jaws, bat wings, spiky back.

La Brivia, the vibria of Sant Llorenc del Munt: a fierce winged serpent-dragon, side view facing right, teal and black scales, long serpent tail instead of legs at the back, large bat wings, golden belly.
The dragon of Banyoles lake, side view facing right: blue aquatic dragon with fins on the back, webbed feet, shiny wet scales.
A friendly vegetarian dragon, side view facing right: light green, chubby, big smile, a red rose tucked behind its ear, holding a lettuce.

The Drac de Vilafranca del Penedes, a traditional Catalan festival dragon figure (bestiari festiu) documented since 1600, side view facing right: dark green skin, carved wooden head with an open red mouth, stiff wooden bat wings, long segmented tail, spitting golden firework sparks; it is carried by people hidden under a cloth skirt, their feet visible below the figure.

La Mulassa de Reus, a traditional Catalan festival beast figure (bestiari festiu), side view facing right: a big dark mule figure with a decorated red and gold caparison and a long skirt hiding the bearers (their feet visible below), fireworks on its head spraying sparks.

La Cucafera de Tortosa, a traditional Catalan festival beast figure, side view facing right: half dragon half turtle, big domed green shell, long extendable neck with a dragon head and snapping jaws with a red mouth, carried by people hidden under a skirt below the shell, their feet visible.

La Guita Xica of the Patum de Berga, a traditional Catalan festival beast figure, side view facing right: dragon head on a very long giraffe-like neck, mule body covered with a dark cloth, horse tail, golden fireworks spitting sparks from its mouth, carried by people hidden under the cloth with their feet visible.
A single red rose with a green stem and two leaves, upright.
A closed old hardcover book seen at an angle, red cover with gold decoration.
A white woolly sheep standing, side view facing right, black face and black legs.
